name: UI Clicks, Taps & Buttons
when_to_use: Every real cursor click or tap in a screen recording, buttons pressed in app demos, toggles, menu selections, a checklist item ticking, highlighting a UI element, snappy sequences showing several items quickly.

sounds.name: Bright Select Ping 01
sounds.desc: A bright, tonal 340 ms digital ping with a clean decay; use to accept a choice or as a light accent on a highlighted keyword.

sounds.name: Dark Digital Click 01
sounds.desc: A tight 20 ms low digital click with a clean fast decay; ideal for real cursor clicks and button presses in screen recordings.

sounds.name: Dark Digital Click 02

sounds.name: Select Confirm Tap 02

sounds.name: Trackpad Click 01

sounds.name: Hover Blip 01
sounds.desc: A soft tonal hover blip with a short ring. Use it when a cursor rolls over a menu item or button.

sounds.name: Hover Blip 02
sounds.desc: A very short mid-pitched tonal tick. Good for cursor hovers or highlighting list items one by one.

sounds.name: Hover Blip 03
sounds.desc: A bright, wide-stereo short hover tick. Fits menu rollovers and quick selection highlights.

sounds.name: Hover Blip 04
sounds.desc: A soft tonal blip that swells in slightly. Use it on hovers or small UI elements easing in.

sounds.name: Low Hover Thump 01
sounds.desc: A short, dark, low tonal thump. Good for muted hovers or soft button presses.

sounds.name: Low Switch Thump 01
sounds.desc: A deep, sub-heavy tonal thump with an instant attack; use it for a heavy toggle or a soft emphasis knock on a key word.

sounds.name: Low Switch Thump 02
sounds.desc: A low switch thump with a brighter click on top, landing about 0.1 s in; use it for a weighty toggle or button press.

sounds.name: Low Switch Thump 03
sounds.desc: A dark, bassy tonal switch that swells for 0.1 s then stops; use it for a toggle turning off or a muted button press.

sounds.name: Low UI Thock 01
sounds.desc: A short rounded low-mid thock with some body. Use it for soft button presses or menu selections in an app demo.

sounds.name: Low UI Thock 02
sounds.desc: A very short, dull, dark click. Good for understated taps on buttons or cards.

sounds.name: Micro Digital Tick 07
sounds.desc: An extremely high, thin 30 ms tick; only for very subtle hover sparkle or as a layered detail.

sounds.name: Micro Switch Tick 01
sounds.desc: A tiny, quiet tick. Use it for subtle hovers or light word-highlight accents.

sounds.name: Micro Switch Tick 02
sounds.desc: A tiny, very bright, crisp tick. Good for rapid selection taps or highlighting a caption word.

sounds.name: Micro UI Tick 01
sounds.desc: An extremely short, dry digital tick of about 10 ms. Ideal for hover ticks, fast selection sequences or letter-by-letter type-on.
sounds.credit_line: "UI buttons | Sound effects pack + GLITCHES" by kasse (https://pknm.itch.io/ui-buttons-sound-effects-pack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Micro UI Tick 02
sounds.desc: A tiny, bright, slightly noisy digital tick with a 35 ms tail. Use it for hover states, quick multi-item selections or digital type-on ticks.
sounds.credit_line: "UI buttons | Sound effects pack + GLITCHES" by kasse (https://pknm.itch.io/ui-buttons-sound-effects-pack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Mid UI Click 01
sounds.desc: A mid-range digital click with a wide stereo spread and a short tail. Use it for menu selections and button presses in app demos.
sounds.credit_line: "UI buttons | Sound effects pack + GLITCHES" by kasse (https://pknm.itch.io/ui-buttons-sound-effects-pack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Mid UI Click 02
sounds.desc: A quiet, soft mid-range click with a quick decay. Good for subtle cursor clicks or highlighting a UI element without drawing attention.
sounds.credit_line: "UI buttons | Sound effects pack + GLITCHES" by kasse (https://pknm.itch.io/ui-buttons-sound-effects-pack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Mid UI Click 03
sounds.desc: A clean, mid-bright digital click with a short tail. Use it for cursor clicks, checkbox ticks or quick menu selections.
sounds.credit_line: "UI buttons | Sound effects pack + GLITCHES" by kasse (https://pknm.itch.io/ui-buttons-sound-effects-pack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Minimal Double Tick 01
sounds.desc: A bright minimal tick with a short second accent, about 160 ms in total; use for a toggle or switch in a UI demo.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Minimal Double Tick 02
sounds.desc: A very bright, airy tick that builds into a second accent at about 125 ms; use for a toggle switching on.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Minimal Double Tick 03
sounds.desc: A very bright two-step tick with its louder accent at about 125 ms; good for a toggle or a confirm tap.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Minimal Double Tick 04
sounds.desc: A bright tick that lands its main accent at about 200 ms and ends by 0.32 s; use for a toggle or a select-then-confirm tap.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Minimal Double Tick 05
sounds.desc: A bright, two-part minimal tick lasting about a quarter second; suits a toggle flipping or a quick double-tap in an app demo.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Mouse Click Quiet 01
sounds.desc: A quiet, bright real mouse click with some extra mechanism noise in a 2-second take; trim it and raise the gain for cursor clicks in screen recordings.

sounds.name: Mouse Click Thin 01
sounds.desc: A bright, very high-frequency mouse-button release tick. Pair it after the press for a realistic click.

sounds.name: Mouse Double Click 03
sounds.desc: An Apple Magic Mouse double click; use it for opening files or apps in a screen recording, but check the very first click is not cut short.

sounds.name: Muted Switch Click 01
sounds.desc: A rounded, mid-toned switch click with a short decay. Fits toggles and settings being flipped.

sounds.name: Muted Switch Click 02
sounds.desc: A darker, softer switch click. Good for understated toggles or a checkbox being ticked.

sounds.name: Muted Switch Click 03
sounds.desc: A mid-toned, clean switch click with a short decay. Good for toggles and settings changes.

sounds.name: Muted Switch Click 04
sounds.desc: A softer, mid-toned switch click with a gradual build into the snap. Good for gentle toggles.

sounds.name: Muted Switch Click 05
sounds.desc: A clean, rounded switch click. Good for toggles, checkboxes and option selections.

sounds.name: Processed Click 01
sounds.desc: Bright processed digital click with a short ringing tail; use for button presses or menu selections in a screen recording.
sounds.credit_line: "UI Clicky Sound and FX Pack" by Gmorkh (https://gmorkh.itch.io/uiscp), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Processed Click 02
sounds.desc: Rounder, more tonal processed click with a ringing tail, louder than its sibling; use for a confirmed button press or selecting a card.
sounds.credit_line: "UI Clicky Sound and FX Pack" by Gmorkh (https://gmorkh.itch.io/uiscp), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Select Tone Blip 01
sounds.desc: A high, tonal select blip with a fast attack and about 0.2 s ring; use it for confirming a menu choice or ticking a list item. It pairs with 02 and 03 as a pitched set.

sounds.name: Select Tone Blip 02
sounds.desc: The mid-pitched version of the tonal select blip; use it for menu selections or as the middle step of a stacked list.

sounds.name: Select Tone Blip 03
sounds.desc: The lowest version of the tonal select blip, warmer and softer; use it for button taps or the first step of a pitched list.

sounds.name: Soft Select Tick 01
sounds.desc: A tiny, tonal 40 ms select tick at very low level; use it for subtle hover or menu-highlight moments after adding gain.

sounds.name: Soft Select Tick 02
sounds.desc: A slightly lower 40 ms tonal select tick at very low level; use it for hover ticks or highlighting menu items.

sounds.name: Soft UI Hover Blip 01
sounds.desc: A soft-attack, mid-bright UI blip that eases in rather than snapping. Suits hover states, menu highlights or a gentle select.
sounds.credit_line: "UI buttons | Sound effects pack + GLITCHES" by kasse (https://pknm.itch.io/ui-buttons-sound-effects-pack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Switch Toggle 01
sounds.desc: Quick bright switching click with a short tail; use for toggles flipping on or off or switching tabs in an app demo.
sounds.credit_line: "UI Clicky Sound and FX Pack" by Gmorkh (https://gmorkh.itch.io/uiscp), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Switch Toggle 02
sounds.desc: Louder click-switch with a slightly longer bright tail; use for a decisive toggle or mode switch.
sounds.credit_line: "UI Clicky Sound and FX Pack" by Gmorkh (https://gmorkh.itch.io/uiscp), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Toggle Switch Click 02
sounds.desc: A crisp mid-bright toggle-switch click. Use it when switches or settings flip in an app demo.

sounds.name: Toggle Switch Click 03
sounds.desc: A clean mid-bright switch click. Fits toggles, checkbox ticks and settings flips.

sounds.name: Toggle Switch Click 04
sounds.desc: A short, crisp toggle click with a tight start. Use it on quick settings flips.

sounds.name: Toggle Switch Click 05
sounds.desc: A clean, short switch click. Fits toggles, checkbox ticks and quick UI presses.

sounds.name: Toggle Switch Click 06
sounds.desc: A clean, mid-bright toggle click after a 90 ms lead-in. Fits settings flips once trimmed.

sounds.name: Toggle Switch Click 07
sounds.desc: A bright-leaning toggle click with a bit of noise. Use it for switch flips and button presses.

sounds.name: Two-Stage Switch Click 01
sounds.desc: A soft pre-click followed by the main switch snap about 150 ms later. Use it for a toggle that engages or latches.

sounds.name: Two-Stage Switch Click 02
sounds.desc: A very bright two-part switch click, with the main snap after a light pre-click. Use it for an engage or latch toggle.

sounds.name: Two-Stage Switch Click 03
sounds.desc: A switch click followed by a second softer click, like an on-off flick. Good for a toggle flicked on and back.

sounds.name: UI Back Tick 01
sounds.desc: A very short bright synthetic tick for a back or cancel button; use on a quick tap or menu step in an app demo.

sounds.name: UI Back Tick 02
sounds.desc: A short mellow tonal tick with a clean decay; use for a back, cancel or menu tap in a screen recording.

sounds.name: UI Back Tick 03
sounds.desc: A crisp 90 ms digital tick with a little body; use on a button press or menu selection in an app demo.

sounds.name: UI Back Tick 04
sounds.desc: A soft rounded tonal tick; use for a subtle back or close tap when the cursor clicks in a screen recording.

sounds.name: UI Toggle Click 04
sounds.desc: A short 60 ms toggle tick, softer and tighter than the others; use it for quick on/off taps or fast checklist ticks.
